newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil cruises higher with futures.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil cruises higher with futures.

text.p: NWE gas oil surged higher on Thursday on the back of stronger IPE futures, but premiums were a touch weaker.

February IPE gas oil closed up $7.50 a tonne at $212.25 on the back of storming NYMEX heating oil that was boosted by bullish U.S distillate inventory data and forecasts of colder weather in the northeast.
Heating oil premiums came under a little pressure with Russian product easing 25 cents down to Feb IPE +$2.75/3.75 and FOD down about $1 to Feb IPE +$5/6.
Diesel premiums were stronger, bolstered by thin offerings.
February was bid at $18 and offered at +$20, gains of $2/4 a tonne.

One trader who bought a Russian at quotes mean of means +50 cents cif NWE for early Feb delivery was understood to be looking for more material, some of which could find its way transatlantic. Difficulties in finding suitable shipping and the high freight cost remained.
The barge market was relatively quiet with refinery material trading between Feb IPE +$2/2.25, broadly steady on Wednesday.
